timeline.body:
Motivation:

Not long ago, I have modified the LengthFieldBasedFrameDecoder class to skip frames of parsed, however, we should be allowed to repeat reading frame, to meet their business expansion

Modification:

allow repeat read frame

Result:

Fixes #12171.

timeline.author: 黄俊

timeline.body:
For what it's worth, an opinion on the change. 

This does not address the core of the issue, the fact is the previous change have broken a public API promise. With this proposed change implementations that override the protected methods are still broken. Provided they relied on previous behaviour where `getUnadjustedFrameLength` was called multiple times. The only way to fix this is to revert the change.

Now if you want to expose some new API, e.g. something an implementor of the `getUnadjustedFrameLength` can call to signal that there will be no more changes to the provided frame length that is fine. You can then go ahed and update any existing implementation that need the optimisation.

E.g. instead of `public void resetFrameLengthInt()` have a `public void memoizeFrameLength()` after calling that no more calls to the `getUnadjustedFrameLength` will be made. The last emitted value would stand.

Further, more if you do want to keep this change, go ahead and use the new API e.g. line:445 in the current implementation should really use it as well.
